name: Quantum_Cognitive_Framework
description: Models cognitive processes through quantum probability theory, superposition of mental states, and contextual decision-making beyond classical Bayesian frameworks.

name: Information_Thermodynamic_Bridge
description: Unifies Landauer's principle with statistical mechanics to bridge physical entropy and information-theoretic entropy in computational systems.

name: Causal_Emergence_Theory
description: Formalizes how higher-level causal structures can emerge from lower-level dynamics with greater effective information than their microscopic constituents.

name: Consciousness_Field_Framework
description: Treats consciousness as a fundamental field phenomenon emerging from integrated information dynamics across neural substrates.

name: Holographic_Complexity_Framework
description: Applies holographic principle and AdS/CFT duality to understand complexity as boundary phenomenon encoding bulk information.

name: Predictive_Processing_Unified
description: Hierarchical Bayesian brain model unifying perception, action, and cognition through free energy minimization and active inference.

name: Network_Causality_Integrator
description: Combines graphical causal models with complex network theory to discover and validate causal structures in interconnected systems.

name: Topological_Phase_Framework
description: Classifies emergent physical phases through topological invariants and Berry phase geometry, connecting condensed matter to mathematical topology.

name: Axiomatic_Meta_Framework
description: Provides meta-axiomatic structures for comparing, translating, and unifying different formal systems across scientific domains.

name: Self_Organized_Criticality_Theory
description: Explains how complex systems naturally evolve toward criticality without fine-tuning, producing scale-free patterns and power-law distributions.

name: Quantum_Error_Correction_Framework
description: Protects quantum information from decoherence through redundant encoding in entangled states across multiple physical qubits.

name: Evolving_Fitness_Landscape_Theory
description: Models adaptation and evolutionary dynamics on rugged, time-dependent fitness landscapes with epistatic interactions and genetic constraints.

name: Renormalization_Group_Unification
description: Uses renormalization group flow to connect microscopic physics to macroscopic phenomena through systematic scale transformations.

name: Integrated_Information_Theory_Extension
description: Extended IIT framework computing phi (Φ) for arbitrary causal architectures to identify consciousness in biological and artificial systems.

name: Quantum_Field_Cognition_Bridge
description: Maps quantum field theoretic concepts onto cognitive architectures, treating concepts as field excitations and cognitive states as field configurations.

name: Information_Geometry_Framework
description: Applies differential geometry to probability distributions, studying statistical manifolds with Fisher information metric for inference and learning.

name: Causal_Loop_Analysis_Framework
description: Identifies and analyzes feedback loops in complex causal systems, detecting reinforcement and balancing dynamics across temporal scales.

name: Thermodynamic_Computing_Framework
description: Reimagines computation as a thermodynamic process, optimizing energy efficiency near Landauer limit and exploiting thermal fluctuations.

name: Quantum_Gravity_Info_Framework
description: Investigates quantum gravity through the lens of quantum information theory, connecting entanglement, geometry, and spacetime emergence.

name: Swarm_Intelligence_Framework
description: Models collective behavior and distributed problem-solving in decentralized agent systems with local interactions and emergent global intelligence.

name: Tensor_Network_Physics
description: Represents quantum many-body states and processes as tensor networks, enabling efficient classical simulation and theoretical analysis.

name: Consciousness_Causal_Framework
description: Combines causal inference with consciousness studies to identify necessary and sufficient causal structures for phenomenal experience.

name: Game_Theoretic_Emergence
description: Studies how strategic interactions among agents produce emergent social, economic, and biological patterns through evolutionary game dynamics.

name: Quantum_Machine_Learning_Bridge
description: Integrates quantum computing with machine learning, developing quantum-enhanced algorithms for classification, optimization, and generative modeling.

name: Symmetry_Breaking_Framework
description: Analyzes how spontaneous symmetry breaking creates ordered phases, Goldstone modes, and emergent physical laws from symmetric foundations.

name: Bayesian_Causal_Discovery
description: Bayesian approach to learning causal graph structures from observational data, scoring models by posterior probability and marginal likelihood.

name: Complex_Adaptive_System_Framework
description: Models systems of interacting adaptive agents that co-evolve with their environment, producing emergent behavior through local adaptation rules.

name: Quantum_Decomposition_Theory
description: Studies how quantum systems decompose into classical and quantum subsystems, characterizing quantum-to-classical transitions and quantum correlations.

name: Free_Energy_Minimization_Framework
description: Extends Friston's free energy principle to general self-organizing systems, treating existence as minimization of variational free energy.

name: Homotopy_Type_Theory_Bridge
description: Connects homotopy type theory with physical theories, providing constructive foundations for geometric and topological physics.

name: Quantum_Cryptography_Framework
description: Develops information-theoretically secure communication protocols exploiting quantum mechanical properties like no-cloning and entanglement.

name: Nonlinear_Dynamics_Framework
description: Comprehensive framework for analyzing nonlinear dynamical systems including chaos, bifurcations, strange attractors, and bifurcation diagrams.

name: Categorical_Quantum_Mechanics
description: Reformulates quantum mechanics in the language of category theory, using dagger compact closed categories and monoidal categories.

name: Ecological_Network_Dynamics
description: Models species interactions, food web stability, and ecosystem resilience through network analysis and dynamical systems theory.

name: Quantum_Sensing_Framework
description: Develops quantum-enhanced sensing protocols achieving measurement precision beyond classical limits using entanglement and squeezed states.

name: Epistemic_Logic_Framework
description: Formalizes knowledge, belief, and information flow among agents using modal logic systems with common knowledge and distributed knowledge operators.

name: Reaction_Diffusion_Pattern_Framework
description: Analyzes Turing-type pattern formation in biological, chemical, and physical systems through activator-inhibitor reaction-diffusion dynamics.

name: Quantum_Many_Body_Framework
description: Studies emergent phenomena in quantum many-body systems including quantum phase transitions, topological order, and many-body localization.

name: Algorithmic_Information_Framework
description: Based on algorithmic information theory and Kolmogorov complexity, providing objective measures of randomness, structure, and information content.

name: Socio_Technical_System_Framework
description: Analyzes complex interactions between human social systems and technological infrastructure for designing resilient, adaptive socio-technical solutions.

name: Quantum_Trajectory_Framework
description: Individual quantum state trajectories in continuous measurement, connecting quantum measurement theory to open quantum system dynamics.

name: Morphological_Computation_Framework
description: Investigates how physical body morphology contributes to computation and control in biological and robotic systems.

name: Quantum_Estimation_Framework
description: Optimal quantum parameter estimation theory achieving Heisenberg-limited precision through carefully designed quantum probes and measurements.

name: Catastrophe_Theory_Framework
description: Mathematical theory of sudden discontinuous changes in continuous systems, classifying bifurcation types and threshold behaviors.

name: Quantum_Walk_Framework
description: Quantum analog of classical random walks exhibiting ballistic spreading, topological phases, and universal computation capabilities.

name: Information_Bottleneck_Framework
description: Optimal information-theoretic framework for finding compressed representations that preserve relevant information about a target variable.

name: Quantum_Biology_Framework
description: Explores quantum coherence and quantum effects in biological systems including photosynthesis, avian magnetoreception, and enzyme catalysis.

name: Distributed_Ledger_Framework
description: Applies distributed ledger and blockchain technology to create tamper-proof records of scientific axioms and computational provenance.

name: Cognitive_Radical_Embedding_Framework
description: Embeds cognitive representations in high-dimensional continuous spaces using radical embedding theory to capture conceptual similarity and relational structure.

name: Quantum_Contextuality_Framework
description: Formalizes quantum contextuality through sheaf-theoretic and graph-theoretic approaches, characterizing measurement context-dependence beyond nonlocality.
